name: W Roma
positioning: W Rome, set behind the facades of two 19th-century palazzos on Via Liguria, a stroll from the Spanish Steps and Trevi Fountain, with a 6th-floor WET DECK plunge pool and suites with private terraces
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Piazza di Spagna, the Trevi Fountain and the Pantheon
Design lovers drawn to a historic palazzo reworked with contemporary Italian design and suites with city-view terraces

facts.text: The hotel's address is 26/36 Via Liguria, Rome.
Piazza di Spagna, the Trevi Fountain, the Pantheon and Piazza Navona are within a stroll of the hotel.
Guestrooms are inspired by Italian design icons Carlo Scarpa and Ettore Sottsass.
The interiors feature repeating arches, layered marble and references to landmarks like the Pantheon and Palazzo della Civilta Italiana.
The Penthouse Suite is on the top floor.
The Supreme Suite is on the fifth floor and has an expansive private terrace with outdoor living and dining spaces overlooking the city's skyline.
Some Urban Suites have a private outdoor garden or terrace.
Select W Suites can connect to adjoining rooms.
Bathrooms are stocked with Davines amenities and a Dyson Supersonic hairdryer.
Giano Restaurant is the hotel's Sicilian restaurant, led by Head Chef Ciccio Sultano.
W Lounge is the hotel's any-hours bar with live music, DJ sets and cocktails.
The FIT gym has Technogym equipment.

highlights.text: The hotel sits behind the facades of two 19th-century palazzos.
The WET DECK is on the 6th floor.
The rooftop has a plunge pool with panoramic views of the city.
The Penthouse Suite opens onto an extensive private terrace with sweeping views across Rome's rooftops.
A hand-painted mural by Italian artist Costanza Alvarez de Castro is inspired by Roman gardens.

considerations.text: The rooftop pool is a plunge pool.
Pets are welcome through the Pets Are Welcome (P.A.W.) program.
WhataHotel notes the bold modern design may not suit travelers who prefer a traditional style.
